modules.description: Core lattice-threaded data reduction engine. Transforms millions of entities into a compact survivor set using multi-resolution thinning and composite scoring.
Data governance and lineage tracking for the Latent Ocean data estate. Monitors data quality, provenance, and compliance across all modules.
Financial intelligence via SEC EDGAR filings. Ingests 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings and extracts structural relationships between companies, executives, and financial metrics.
Real-time graph-state monitoring for the reduction pipeline. Tracks well health, throughput, and system metrics across reduction stages.
Patent landscape analysis via USPTO and EPO databases. Maps innovation networks, technology clusters, and competitive patent portfolios.
Medical and pharmaceutical intelligence via PubMed and clinical trial databases. Maps research networks, drug pipelines, and institutional relationships.
Football analytics and scouting intelligence. Reduces large player datasets to identify undervalued talent using structural intelligence.
Topological crystallization and structural discovery via JEPA-based representation learning. Identifies hidden structural patterns in survivor sets.
Global trade and supply-chain analysis via UN Comtrade data. Tracks commodity flows, trade dependencies, and supply-chain vulnerabilities.
